title: Purple Sorceress
description: A young female character with short white hair stands in a dynamic combat pose against a plain gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-style outfit with armored elements, wields a glowing purple energy whip in her right hand, and casts a swirling purple magical effect from her raised left hand.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian woman with short messy white hair and purple eyes, wearing a white and purple East Asian inspired fantasy battle outfit with armored plates and flowing fabric, stands in a combat stance. She holds a crackling purple energy whip in one hand while casting a swirling purple magical orb from her other hand, purple arcane halo floating above her head, dynamic pose, clean digital illustration style.
